# Runecast

> Runecast is a fast, free and open-source (MIT) keyboard launcher for macOS and Linux, inspired by Raycast and built in Rust with Rune. Press Option+Space (Alt+Space on Linux), type a few letters, and hit Return.

Features:

- Fuzzy app search, ranked by what you use most, plus favorites
- File search
- Clipboard history (Control+Option+V)
- Window management on macOS: halves, maximize, center (Control+Option+arrow keys)
- Snippets, quicklinks and aliases for any app or command
- Calculator and conversions: math, units, currency and time zones (for example `100 usd to php`, `3pm pst in manila`)
- System commands such as dark mode, volume and quitting apps
- World clock, and Claude and ChatGPT plan usage from the Claude Code and Codex sign-in
- Falls back to a web search for anything else

Settings are saved to `config.json` in `~/Library/Application Support/Runecast/` on macOS and `~/.config/runecast/` on Linux. Runecast checks for new releases daily and updates itself on macOS.

## Download

- [Latest macOS DMG](https://github.com/dinogomez/runecast/releases/latest/download/Runecast-latest-macos.dmg): universal build for Apple silicon and Intel
- [All releases](https://github.com/dinogomez/runecast/releases): macOS `.dmg` and `.zip`, Linux x86_64 `.tar.gz`, with first-launch steps in the release notes
